sentences.text:
The Tahsildar, Gadivemula Mandal, Gadivemula,
 Nandyala District, Andhra Pradesh
 ...Respondent(S):
 Petition under Article 226 of the Constitution of India praying that
in the circumstances stated in the affidavit filed therewith, the High
Court may be pleased topleased to pass an order or direction or Writ,
more specifically one in the nature of a writ of mandamus declaring
the action of the respondent revenue authorities in not paying
compensation of Rs 5.50 lakhs per acre as was paid to patta holders
for the same acquisition and instead paying only Rs 4.20 lakhs per
acre in respect of the petitioner's land of Ac 3.25 cents in survey no.
715/Bl in Gani Village of Gadivemula Mandal, Nandyal District,
Andhra pradesh in respect of the land holding of the petitioners
resumed by the respondents as illegal, contrary to the settled law laid
down by the honourable High Court of Andhra Pradesh in 'Mekala
Pandu case and and as confirmed by the Hon'ble Supreme Court in
Civil Appeal No 7904-7912 dated 04-08-2014 and consequently direct
payment of the balance Rs.1.3 lakhs Per acre in respect of the land
holding of the petitioner with all applicable consequential benefits
including interest from the date of taking possession on 03-03-2015
and pass
Counsel for the Petitioner:

sentences.text: Learned counsel for petitioner appeared virtually and submitted that in view of amendment issued vide G.O.Ms.No.23, Revenue (Lands.I), dated 19.01.2024, the Andhra Pradesh Assigned Lands (Prohibition of Transfers) (Amendment) Act, 2023, this writ petition has been rendered infructuous.

entities.text: Andhra Pradesh Assigned Lands (Prohibition of Transfers) (Amendment) Act, 2023
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: Recording the said submissions, the present Writ Petition is dismissed as infructuous.

However,
petitioner is at liberty to initiate appropriate proceedings, if necessary.
There shall be no order as to costs.
As a sequel thereto, miscellaneous petitions pending, if any shall stands closed.
